admission.justification: Brief generation, post-landing and manual CLI refresh, honest location.current short-answer notices, and role-start change reports jointly keep detailed file knowledge accurate and reachable when bounded replies omit full text.

guarantee: A reader can recover governing file knowledge from its selected task memory. A current source brief contains the detail omitted from a bounded reply, short-answer notices direct callers to open a saved brief only when location.current is true, and external-memory landings (integration, checkpoint, and recorded PR landings with matching HEAD) plus the manual agents-remember memory-briefs CLI keep derived briefs refreshed while surfacing any refresh failure strictly as an advisory briefsProblem. An eligible converted role start gives the recipient a separate change report.
title: File knowledge through briefs and start notices
